title: Store Initialization and Hydration
description: Learn how to initialize and hydrate the Redux store from persisted state.

data.text: Store initialization with persisted state lets you preserve Redux state across page reloads and browser sessions.

data.title: Store Hydration
Security
data.text: Never persist sensitive data like auth tokens in Redux state or localStorage.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Subscribe to state changes for persistence
